Commentary.Commentary: Right. That is all we have from this game. Scotland go up in the series and would look to seal the series in the second T20I, whereas, Zimbabwe would want to bounce back in the next game. The second T20I will be played on Friday, 17th September 2021 at 2 pm local (1 pm GMT), but, the build-up will begin early. Do join us then. Cheers!

The bowling by Scotland was good at the start, but they lost their way in the middle overs slightly as they were not able to contain a couple of the Zimbabwean batters, but, they bounced back really well towards the back end of the innings and that saw them end on the right side of the result. Safyaan Sharif was definitely the pick of the lot as he ended with figures of 4-0-24-4 and started and ended the innings well for the Scots. All of their bowlers bowled well and were very economical and with the exception of Michael Leask, all the bowlers had at least one wicket to their name. Overall, a combined bowling effort sees them go up in this series.

Zimbabwe had a torrid start to the run chase as they lost both their openers in the span of the first three overs. They found it hard to keep the runs flowing but the duo of Regis Chakabva and Craig Ervine did well to stitch a stand of 48, but both of them could not go on for longer and they both lost their wicket. Milton Shumba and Sean Williams played smartly and ensured that they did not lose any more wickets as they forged a 54-run stand and they looked like they would take their team home, but, at the wrong time, Williams lost his wicket. Shumba tried hard towards the end but he was not able to help his team win the game.

A superb bowling display and comeback from Scotland as they have won this game by 7 runs and they go 1-0 up in this 3-game T20I series! At one stage, it looked like Zimbabwe would run home with the game as they need just 33 in the last 4 overs, but the Scots held their nerve in the death to cross the line.
Full ball, on off. Milton Shumba drives it hard towards long off and can only take a single. Scotland win the match by 7 runs and they go 1-0 up in the series.
Length ball, on middle. Milton Shumba heaves it towrads deep mid-wicket but does not take the run.

OUT! RUN OUT! Another one bites the dust! Tendai Chatara sacrifices his wicket for Milton Shumba. Length ball, on off. Tendai Chatara taps it to the right of the bowler and looks to take a run. Safyaan Sharif runs to collect the ball and then scampers through towards the non-striker's end to whip the bails off. Chatara is well short of his crease and he has to depart.
Richard Ngarava is the last man in but luckily for Zimbabwe, Milton Shumba is on strike. Zimbabwe need 9 from 2 balls. Can Shubma take this game to a Super Over?

OUT! BOWLED! What a delivery this is from Safyaan Sharif! He serves in a yorker, around middle. Wellington Masakadza looks to dig it out but misses and the ball disturbs his stumps. Wellington Masakadza has to walk back to the pavilion.
Full ball, around leg. Milton Shumba shuffles across to scoop it but fails to get any bat on it. The keeper fails to collect it cleanly and the batters take a bye!
9 needed from the last 3 balls! Tendai Chatara strides out into the middle now!
FOUR! A great start to the over for Zimbabwe. Length ball, down leg. Milton Shumba whips it off his pads through square leg for a boundary. 10 needed off 5 balls now!
Good-length ball, outside off. Milton Shumba taps it towards point for a run. 14 runs needed from the last over!
Length ball, outside off. Wellington Masakadza looks to heave it but gets an inside edge behind the sticks. They sneak in a run.
Full ball, outside off. Milton Shumba pushes it to cover for one.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a fantastic catch from Safyaan Sharif at deep square leg. Length ball, down leg. Luke Jongwe flicks it towards the deep square leg region where Safyaan Sharif times his jump to perfection and completes a very tough catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Safyaan Sharif b Chris Sole

Commentary.Commentary: Wellington Masakadza walks out!
Full ball, outside off. Milton Shumba looks to dig it out but gets a leading edge towards third man for a run.
Length ball, outside off. Luke Jongwe pushes it to cover for one.
Good-length ball, around off. Luke Jongwe taps it to point for a single. 19 runs needed from 12 balls!
Luke Jongwe arrives!

OUT! BOWLED! Safyaan Sharif strikes for Scotland this time! He serves a full ball, on middle. Ryan Burl looks to scoop it over the short fine leg fielder but he misses and the ball crashes onto his stumps. Huge wicket for Scotland as the dangerous Ryan Burl departs.
Good-length ball, on off. Milton Shumba comes down the track and pushes it to cover for a run.
SIX! SMASHED! Short ball, on middle. Milton Shumba hangs back and hammers it over the square leg region for a maximum!
Length ball, on the pads. Worked towards wide long on for a run.
Short ball, on middle. Milton Shumba pulls it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Milton Shumba works it behind square on the off side and collects a run. 29 needed in 18 balls.
Safyaan Sharif comes back to bowl!
Good-length ball, outside off. Milton Shumba pokes at it but misses as the ball zips past his outside edge.

OUT! CAUGHT! Alasdair Evans has taken a crucial wicket here for Scotland and they are right back in it! Good-length ball, on off. Sean Williams lofts it high in the air towards Michael Leask at long on, who takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Michael Leask b Alasdair Evans

Commentary.Commentary: Ryan Burl is the new man in!
Good-length ball, on leg. Milton Shumba turns it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Length ball, on the pads. Shumba turns it towards mid-wicket for a couple.
Good-length ball, on off. Shumba comes down and pushes it to cover.

SIX! That was huge! What a great over for the visitors as they get 14 from the over! This is loopy, around off, fuller too, Williams gets low and mows a slog-sweep over deep mid-wicket. 33 more needed from 24 balls!
Fuller, outside off, Shumba works this through mid off for a run.
On middle and leg, Milton pushes this into the gap through mid on and they come back for the second run.
On middle again, swept this time, straight to deep square leg for one.
FOUR! Zimbabwe are doing well to keep the boundaries coming. Fullish, floated too, on middle and leg, Williams gets low and powers his sweep behind deep square leg for a boundary.
Around off, pushed to covers this time.
FOUR! SMASHED! Flatter ball, on middle and leg. Milton Shumba rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed up, outside off. Sean Williams pushes it to cover for a single.
2 Wides! Oliver sprays down leg. Milton Shumba misses the flick and the keeper fumbles. They take a run.
Flatter ball, on leg. Sean Williams flicks it towards deep square leg for a run.
Quicker ball, darted on the pads. Milton Shumba works it on the leg side for one.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Tossed up, on off. Milton Shumba advances down and lofts it over the bowler for a boundary.
Tossed up, on off. Sean Williams looks to sweep but misses and gets rapped on the pads. They take a leg bye.
A bumper outside off, Shumba leaves it, probably thinks that this would be a wide, but the umpire is unmoved. 61 more needed in 36 balls.
Sean Williams tucks this through square leg and hands the strike back to Milton.
Good-length delivery, on middle, Sean flicks this one hard through mid-wicket and a couple of runs are taken.
On middle, worked to the leg side for one.
FOUR! This is what the visitors need. Shumba is delivering for his side here! On a length, around off and middle, Milton Shumba swings and sends the ball over mid on for a boundary.
Length-ball on middle, Milton works this, but only finds the mid-wicket fielder.
On a length, outside off, MS works this past covers and the batters take one.
A short ball this time, around off and middle, pulled powerfully through square leg and the batters cross ends.
FOUR! That was a crisp shot. Zimbabwe need some more boundaries right now! Overpitched ball, outside off, Sean Williams leans into the shot and drives it firmly through covers.
On the body, on a length too, Milton nurdles this to the leg side for a single.
Outside off on a length, driven nicely to sweeper cover for a run.
Good-length ball on off, hit across the line, but only to the short mid-wicket fielder.
Quicker, on middle, worked past mid-wicket for a run. 77 more needed in 48 balls!
Floated, around off, SW works this to covers.
Darted on middle, Williams only manages to fend this one out to the leg side.
Around off, fuller, Sean pushes this to the cover region.
On middle, turnt towards mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter, outside off, Milton misses his cut.
Tossed up, on off, Sean drives but only finds the fielder at covers.
Around off and middle, Milton eases this towards long on for one.
FOUR! Milton Shumba gets off the mark in style! Oliver Hairs drifts this one down the leg side, Milton Shumba gets low and sweeps this hard to the deep square leg fence.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a good catch in the deep and the Zimbabwean skipper loses out and they lose their fourth. Scotland are on top at the moment. This is tossed up, fuller on off and middle, Ervine slams this one towards long on, as he looks for the biggie, but he has not timed this well. It goes towards the man there, George Munsey, who holds onto the catch. 84 more needed in 57 balls!
Commentary.Howout: c George Munsey b Oliver Hairs

Commentary.Commentary: Quicker, fuller, on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
On middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated, outside off. Sean Williams drives it to the cover fielder who fumbles and they take one. 85 needed in 60 balls!
Flatter and quicker, around off. Sean Williams taps it to cover-point.
Flaoted, around middle and leg. Sean Williams looks to reverse sweep but gets the inner half of the bat and the ball goes towards fine leg. The batters take two.
Tossed up, on middle and leg. Sean Williams blocks it out watchfully.
Quicker ball, outside off. Sean Williams gets back and cuts it to point.
Loopy ball, outside off. Sean Williams comes forward and pushes it to cover.
Flatter ball, on leg. Sean Williams tucks it towards the leg side for a single.
Tossed up, around off. Sean Williams defends it out.
Sean Williams is the new man in!
OUT! LBW! Tossed up, on middle and leg. Regis Chakabva gets low to sweep but he misses and gets rapped on the pads. Scotland appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Zimbabwe lose their third wicket.
Flatter ball, on middle. Worked towards the leg side for one.
SIX! WHACKED! Tossed up, on off. Craig Ervine lofts it over the long on region for a maximum!
Flatter ball, on leg. Turned towards square leg for a run.
Short ball, on off. Craig Ervine cuts it hard through covers for a couple.
Flatter ball, on middle. Tucked away towards square leg for a run.
A tad short, on off. Craig Ervine rocks back and cuts it towards cover for a run.
Short ball, outside off. Craig Ervine cuts it hard through extra cover for a couple.
Flatter ball, on off. Craig Ervine hits it back to the bowler.
Tossed up, on off. Craig Ervine comes forward to block this one out.
Flatter ball, on off. Craig Ervine gets behind and works it down the ground for a run.
Floated, around middle. Regis Chakabva advances down and flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Regis Chakabva defends it out.
FOUR! Nicely done! Tossed up, on middle. Regis Chakabva gets low and reverse-sweeps it past the point fielder for a boundary.
Flatter ball, outside off. Craig Ervine cuts it to sweeper cover for a run.
Tossed up, on off. Pushed to covers for a run.
Length ball, on off. Craig Ervine taps it towards backward point. Zimbabwe are 31/2 at the end of the Powerplay.
Back of a length, on off. Craig Ervine blocks it out.
Good-length ball, on off. Craig Ervine taps it to point.
FOUR! SHOT! Full ball, outside off. Craig Ervine comes forward and drives it through extra cover for a boundary.
Back of a length, around off. Ervine guides it towards third man for a couple.
Good-length ball, outside off. Craig Ervine looks to poke at it but misses.
Another run as this is tucked to the leg side.
Outside off, length, hit hard to the right of mid off for one.
A bumper this time, outside off, Regis skips down and swings his blade at this but misses.
Outside off, a slash and a miss from Regis.
FOUR! Cheeky stuff! On a length, around off and middle, Regis Chakabva shuffles and just paddles this one over the man, to the fine leg fence.
Around off, dabbed past point for a single.
This is bowled fuller, on the pads again, CE misses his tuck and the ball goes to short fine leg via the pads. A leg bye is taken.
On a length, around leg, Craig looks to flick but misses and the ball takes the pad and goes to the off side. An appeal but this looked to be pitching outside leg and hence, the umpire says no.
A bumper on middle and leg, Ervine just gets low and lets the ball pass.
Fullish, on off, tucked past mid-wicket for one.
WIDE. Another one which is way outside off. Wide signalled.
WIDE. On a length, way outside off, left alone this time.
Chris Sole serves a length ball on the pads, Craig tries to tuck but misses and the ball takes the pad and goes to the leg side, for a leg bye.
WIDE. This is slipped down the leg side, Ervine misses his tuck. Wide signalled.
A touch short, outside off, guided past point, towards third man for a run.
Around middle, back of a length, Craig looks to tuck but misses and gets hit high on the pad.
WIDE. Down the leg side, left alone by Ervine.
FOUR! The skipper gets a boundary now! In the arc around off, on a length too, Craig Ervine punches this one past the man at mid off and gets a boundary.
Around off and middle, this is tapped to the leg side.
WIDE. This is slipped down the leg side, Craig Ervine looks to tuck but misses. Wide signalled.
Craig Ervine walks out to bat.
Fuller outside off, Ervine leaves it alone.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one falls and both the Zimbabwean openers are back in the shed. Scotland will be delighted with this start and the visitors are struggling to get some momentum here. On a length, around off, Marumani looks for the big shot across the line, but the ball takes the inside edge and flies towards short fine leg, where the man, Alasdair Evans goes low to his right and pouches this.
Commentary.Howout: c Alasdair Evans b Safyaan Sharif

Commentary.Commentary: A touch short, on the body this time, Tadiwanashe Marumani awkwardly fends this one to deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Yorker, on off, Regis Chakabva only manages to jam this one out to the mid on fielder.
On the body this time, this is nudged to the on side for a run.
Fullish ball, way outside off, TM tries to reach out and play at this but misses his shot.
Back of a length, on off, Marumani taps this to the off side and looks for one, but it sent back by his partner.
Marumani drives this, but only manages to find the cover fielder.
Around off, on a length, Regis Chakabva pushes this to covers and takes one.
Who will start from the other end?
A brilliant start by Safyaan Sharif as he concedes just one run and also takes a wicket! Outside off, on a length, Tadiwanashe Marumani swings at this but misses.
Short of a length, on the body, Marumani nudges this one to the leg side.
Length ball, slanting away, Tadiwanashe Marumani skips down and looks to whack it away but misses his shot.
Zimbabwe are up and running! On a length, on off, tapped to the off side for a quick single.
Length around off, pushed to covers.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! That is the perfect start for the hosts and Zimbabwe lose their first wicket. A torrid start for the visitors and this is not what they would have wanted. A touch short, way outside off, Wesley Madhevere looks to slash this one away but the ball hits the deck and bounces slightly more than what Madhevere expected. The outside edge is induced and Matthew Cross, behind the sticks, makes no mistake.
Commentary.Howout: c Matthew Cross b Safyaan Sharif
